title: The corkboard, 2021
logline: Gully's corkboard in September 2021, the whole inventory: the 2003 rough of Gully hanging the sign, lost-cat flyers, kayak cards, a tide table, tourist snapshots, the printout under page fourteen, the 61 MI postcard, the red-framed crab, TAKE-OUT ONLY. A private page of a public object. Nothing new on it.

panels.composition: A crowded shop corkboard filling the page: a pencil rough of a man hanging a sign, lost-cat flyers, kayak cards, a tide table, tourist snapshots, a yellowed printout with a weekly's page pinned over it, a postcard with marker on its face, a small red-framed crab drawing, a hand-lettered card.
